why: ChatGPT recommends one charger and adds nothing else to buy: its compatibility note on plug, polarity, BMS and charging profile is a check before choosing that charger, not a second item. The fact that decides the page is matching charge voltage (58.4V for a 48V LiFePO4 pack) and current to the battery, which a page comparing chargers and picking one handles. ChatGPT already showed charger cards (Lester, LiTime, Vatrer), so there's no uncarded set to sell.
